cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(AnAnArchiverZlib LANGUAGES C)
if(NOT DEFINED ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE is required")
endif()
set(zlib_sources adler32.c compress.c crc32.c deflate.c gzclose.c gzlib.c gzread.c
    gzwrite.c inflate.c infback.c inftrees.c inffast.c trees.c uncompr.c zutil.c)
list(TRANSFORM zlib_sources PREPEND "${ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE}/")
add_library(zlibstatic STATIC ${zlib_sources})
target_include_directories(zlibstatic PUBLIC "${ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE}")
set_target_properties(zlibstatic PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(zlibstatic PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_WARNINGS)
endif()
if(NOT WIN32)
    set_target_properties(zlibstatic PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME z)
    target_compile_definitions(zlibstatic PRIVATE Z_HAVE_UNISTD_H)
endif()
install(TARGETS zlibstatic ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES "${ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE}/zlib.h" "${ANANARCHIVER_VENDOR_SOURCE}/zconf.h"
    DESTINATION include)
